text_block_list.text: The Tracen Academy annual summer training camp has arrived.

Given her physical condition, we can't push her too hard,
but a change in scenery should still allow for
a fulfilling stretch of training days.
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all, Marvelous.
Let's do our best together, Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes Marvelous☆
The sun is blazing, the ocean is sparkling!
Let's shine just as bright to match them!★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Hey, count me in too!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's Mayano!!
...Huh-uh? Huh-huh-huh-huh☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano!!
Don't tell me you're getting the itch right now!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆
Nothing gets past Mave-chin!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I am.
I'm itching to go, and so excited!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Because... I finally found the sparkle that Maya wants to catch up to, overtake, and never ever lose to!
(Chatter chatter chatter!)

A commotion erupted as if in response
to Mayano Top Gun's declaration.
At the center of it all was—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian-san!!
Brian-san, just one word, please!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
She sat out the Tenno Sho (Spring) due to injury,
but is it true that preparations for her comeback
are already well underway!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
We've had an overwhelming number of celebratory messages from fans and racing insiders alike!
Please, say a few words to the people who are rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I know nothing of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The pain is gone. So I run. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness. Everyone was feeling down,
thinking Narita Brian would follow Fuji Kiseki's footsteps... but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We get to see Narita Brian running as the 'Strongest' again...!
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya wants to race with Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san is strong.
So strong it's beyond belief!!
...Even Maya can't fathom it at all!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I've never done this before!
I have no idea what's going on, and it's so exciting!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why if I run with Brian-san,
I'm sure I'll shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, I want to sparkle!!
Just as brightly as Brian-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya has to get stronger!
So Mave-chin, train with me!
As much as possible during summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of courseーーー☆★☆
Let's do it, let's do lots and lots of it★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Let's boost Mayano's Marvelous together ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪
Nice to meet you too, Mave-chin's Trainer☆

She's from the same generation, and though she stumbled at first,
she's gradually producing results in her races.
I couldn't ask for a better opponent to run with.

And so, I immediately asked
for a joint training session, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~ it's so hooot~~...
But still, not yetttt-!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Full of pep, Marvelous☆★☆
Let's keep running, Mayano★☆★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chan, Maya-chan!
Mind if I jump in too?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Laurel!!
It's Laurel☆ Of course it's fine★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪
Well then, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Laurel, are you super excited
about Brian's comeback too?
Do you feel like being marvelous?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
!
That's true—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *Haah*... *haah*... *haah*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Ghh, GAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Right, yeah.
